description: This file contains unit tests for the WebUtil class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing methods related to locale normalization, context path retrieval, and locales sanitization.

classes.name: WebUtilTest
classes.description: A test class for the WebUtil utility functions, containing multiple test methods to verify behavior of locale normalization, context path retrieval, and locales sanitization.

methods.name: getContextPath_shouldReturnEmptyStringWhenWebAppNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that WebUtil.getContextPath() returns an empty string when WebConstants.WEBAPP_NAME is null.

methods.name: getContextPath_shouldReturnEmptyStringWhenWebAppNameIsEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that WebUtil.getContextPath() returns an empty string when WebConstants.WEBAPP_NAME is an empty string.

methods.name: getContextPath_shouldReturnValueSpecifiedInWebAppName
methods.description: Tests that WebUtil.getContextPath() correctly constructs the path when WebConstants.WEBAPP_NAME is set.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldIgnoreLeadingSpaces
methods.description: Verifies that WebUtil.normalizeLocale() correctly ignores leading spaces in locale strings.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldAcceptLanguageOnlyLocales
methods.description: Verifies that WebUtil.normalizeLocale() correctly handles locale strings with only language codes.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotAcceptInvalidLocales
methods.description: Ensures that invalid locale strings are returned as null.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithEmptyStrings
methods.description: Checks that empty string input results in null and does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithWhitespaceOnly
methods.description: Ensures whitespace-only strings result in null without exceptions.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithTab
methods.description: Tests handling of non-standard control characters that may be present due to encoding.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithUnicode
methods.description: Verifies handling of Unicode characters that are invalid as locale strings.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithSingleChar
methods.description: Checks that single-character strings are handled gracefully.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithUnderline
methods.description: Ensures strings with underscores, which are invalid in locale formats for this context, return null.

methods.name: sanitizeLocales_shouldSkipOverInvalidLocales
methods.description: Tests that invalid locale entries are skipped and only valid locales are included.

methods.name: sanitizeLocales_shouldNotFailWithEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that an empty input string results in a null or empty output without failures.
